one.title: Reliability
one.body: For a business, a missed clean is not a cosmetic issue — it is a problem the next morning. We arrive in the agreed window, including at either end of the day, and tell you ourselves if something comes up. Holidays and sick leave are covered by us, without you having to ask; ideally you never notice the change.

two.title: Quality
two.body: Thoroughness shows in the places you only notice on second glance: skirting boards, door handles, the strip behind the door, the seal around the basin. We work to a fixed checklist per site so the standard does not depend on the day, and we go through that list with you periodically.

three.title: Professionalism
three.body: Our staff are trained, properly employed and background-checked. They move through your premises the way you should move through someone else's: discreetly, without leafing through paperwork, with respect for what is on the desks. Where confidentiality is required — in a medical practice, for instance — we put it in writing.

four.title: Flexibility
four.body: Businesses change: a floor is added, opening hours shift, an event needs one extra visit. We adjust the schedule and the scope rather than insisting on an annual contract, and we invoice what was actually done.

five.title: A Personal Approach
five.body: You have one contact who knows your site — not a hotline and not a rotating cast. That person has been there, knows where the key hangs and which room is occupied on Wednesdays, and is reachable when something has to run differently at short notice.

one.title: Floor area
one.body: Square metres, number of rooms and what is in them. An open-plan office is quicker than the same area split into 20 individual offices with washrooms and a kitchenette.

two.title: Frequency
two.body: Daily, three times a week or once a week. A higher frequency noticeably lowers the effort per visit because less builds up — so the price per clean falls with it.

three.title: Access
three.body: When we can work and how we get in. Cleaning during business hours takes longer than after closing; key handover, alarm systems and lift access all shape the schedule.

one.q: What is included in a standard cleaning?
one.a: Dusting, vacuuming, mopping, cleaning and sanitising the kitchen and bathroom, and tidying all standard living areas. Deep-cleaning work can be added on request.

two.q: Do I need to be home during the cleaning?
two.a: Not at all. Many clients arrange access and go about their day. We agree how we get in with you beforehand, in person.

three.q: What if I am not satisfied with the cleaning?
three.a: Tell us within 24 hours and we will re-clean the area free of charge. That is what our satisfaction guarantee means.

four.q: Do you bring your own cleaning supplies?
four.a: Yes — we arrive with professional, eco-friendly products and the equipment we need. If you would rather we used your own products, just say so.

five.q: Can I customise my cleaning plan?
five.a: Of course. Extras, focus areas and a recurring schedule can be combined however you like — we work it out together when you enquire.

six.a: You receive an invoice after the visit. We agree the payment method when you enquire, so it suits you.

imprint.title: Imprint
imprint.lede: Details required under § 5 of the Austrian E-Commerce Act (ECG) and disclosure under § 25 of the Media Act.

one.body: Magic Shine provides cleaning services for private homes and businesses in Vienna and the surrounding area. The applicable trade regulations and the competent supervisory authority are to be confirmed by the accountant or a lawyer and added here before publication.

two.body: The business is registered as a sole trader (SZČO) in Slovakia; the registration and tax numbers above refer to that registration. The services are performed in Vienna and the surrounding area. Whether an additional Austrian trade registration, a posting notification or a VAT registration is required is for the accountant to clarify before launch.

three.body: If something is not right, please come to us first — most matters are settled in a conversation. Beyond that we are neither obliged nor willing to take part in dispute resolution proceedings before a consumer arbitration body.

four.body: The content of this website is prepared with care. We cannot, however, guarantee that it is accurate, complete or up to date. Statements about prices and services are non-binding until a written quote exists.

five.body: This website currently links to no third-party content. Should external links be added later, the respective provider alone is responsible for their content. At the time of linking we are aware of no unlawful content.

six.body: The text, photographs and design of this website are protected by copyright. Any use beyond the statutory exceptions requires our written consent.

seven.body: The photographs on this website show Magic Shine staff at work and were supplied by the business itself.

eight.h: Disclosure under § 25 of the Media Act
eight.body: The media owner, publisher and party responsible for the content is the owner named above. Editorial direction: presenting the services of Magic Shine and providing information about cleaning services in Vienna and the surrounding area.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lede: How we handle personal data when you visit this website or send us an enquiry.

one.body: The controller for the processing of personal data within the meaning of the GDPR is the owner named in the imprint. You can reach us using the contact details given there.

two.body: This website is a static site with no user accounts, no advertising networks and no analytics or tracking services. We set no cookies that would require consent, and no profiling takes place.

three.body: When you open the site, your browser transmits technically necessary data to the hosting provider: IP address, date and time, the page requested, the volume of data transferred, and browser and operating system identifiers. This data serves secure operation, is not combined with other sources and is deleted after a short period. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. The hosting provider is to be named here before launch, together with a data processing agreement.

four.body: If you write to us through the contact or quote form, we process the details you enter — name, email address, phone number, the details of the property and your message — in order to answer your enquiry and prepare a quote. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (pre-contractual measures). The forms are not yet connected to a service; as soon as they are, the provider will be named here.

five.body: Email currently reaches us through a Google (Gmail) mailbox. We are moving to a mailbox on our own domain before launch. Please do not send us special categories of personal data — health data, for example — by email.

six.body: If you subscribe to the newsletter, we process your email address in order to send you information about services and offers. The legal basis is your consent under Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR, which you may withdraw at any time. The sending service has not yet been chosen and is to be added here before the form goes live.

seven.body: We keep enquiries for as long as we need them to deal with the matter, and beyond that for as long as statutory retention periods require — generally seven years for business records.

eight.body: We pass personal data on only where it is necessary to deliver the service or where the law requires it — to our bookkeeping or tax adviser, for example. Processors are bound by contract under Art. 28 GDPR.

nine.body: You have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability and objection. An informal message to the contact details in the imprint is enough.

ten.body: If you believe the processing of your data infringes the GDPR, you may complain to a supervisory authority — in Austria, the Datenschutzbehörde, Barichgasse 40–42, 1030 Vienna.

eleven.body: We update this policy when our services, our providers or the law change. The version published here is the one that applies.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.lede: The terms on which we provide cleaning services.

one.body: These terms apply to all cleaning services Magic Shine provides for private homes and businesses. Differing terms of the client apply only where we agree to them in writing.

two.body: Statements on this website are non-binding. A contract comes into being when we issue a written quote in response to your enquiry and you accept it. The quote states the scope, the price and the appointment.

three.body: What is included follows from the quote. Additional work is carried out by arrangement and invoiced separately. Work that requires special equipment or authorisation — working at height without safe access, for example — is not part of the service.

four.body: We charge by the hour as a rule; hourly rates start at the figures given on the pricing page. On request we agree a flat rate instead, depending on what you need. For recurring cleaning — weekly or fortnightly — we grant a discount, set individually and recorded in your quote. We bring cleaning products and equipment; special materials or disposal costs are itemised separately.

five.body: We invoice after the work has been done; the invoice is payable within 14 days without deduction. The payment method is agreed when you enquire. Statutory provisions apply in the event of late payment.

six.body: Appointments are binding once agreed. Please cancel an appointment at least 24 hours in advance; for shorter notice, or if we cannot get in at the agreed time, we may charge a reasonable amount for the time reserved. Equally, we will tell you without delay if we cannot keep an appointment and will offer a replacement.

seven.body: We need access to the property, working power and water, and to be told about delicate surfaces, items of particular value and any areas that should not be entered. Keys and access codes are treated confidentially.

eight.body: Please report a complaint within 24 hours of the visit. We will then re-clean the area concerned free of charge. Otherwise the statutory warranty provisions apply.

nine.body: We are liable under the statutory provisions for damage caused intentionally or through gross negligence, and for personal injury. For slight negligence, liability is limited to the value of the order as far as the law permits. Damage must be reported to us without delay so that we can look into it.

ten.body: For contracts concluded off our premises or at a distance, consumers have a statutory right of withdrawal of 14 days. If we begin work before that period expires at your express request, the part performed up to the withdrawal is payable.

eleven.body: We process personal data solely in order to carry out the work. The details are set out in the privacy policy.

twelve.body: Austrian law applies, excluding its conflict-of-law rules. The place of jurisdiction for disputes with businesses is Vienna. Should one provision be invalid, the remainder stay in force.
